lines.en: I run fast across the ground.

lines.zh: 我的影子先一步到前面
lines.en: My shadow arrives a step ahead.

lines.zh: 我拐弯的时候几乎不减速
lines.en: I barely slow when I turn.

lines.zh: 路边的草被我带得倒向一边
lines.en: The grass flattens as I pass.
I run and look back.
A small cloud of dust lifts from my feet.
I run toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我跑起来尾巴往上一翘
lines.en: My tail lifts as I run.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很轻，可频率高
lines.en: My steps are light but quick.

lines.zh: 我在两块石头之间跳了一下
lines.en: I hop between two stones.

lines.zh: 我绕过一棵倒在地上的树
lines.en: I swing around a fallen tree.
I charge down a slope.
I cross the stones without slipping.
I shake my head and run faster.
I stop, breathing fast.

lines.zh: 我左右看着，脖子转得急
lines.en: I look around, neck turning fast.
I lift a foot and set it back.
I paw the ground twice.
My ears point two directions.

lines.zh: 我游得快，耳朵也比我同类灵。
lines.en: I swim faster than my kin, and my ears are keener.
I crouch, then stand at once.

lines.zh: 我游得比同类快，追得上。
lines.en: I swim faster than my kind — I catch you.
I turn to look at my own tail.

lines.zh: 我的前爪在地上按了按
lines.en: I press my forepaw on the ground.
I lift my head; I have caught the sound.
I shake my body once.
I stop and go, in little circles.
One ear forward, one back.
I turn to you very fast.
I check behind you, then at you.
You stand here, and you are too slow.
My feet keep shifting in tiny steps.

lines.zh: 我凑近闻了一下就退开
lines.en: I lean in, sniff once, and pull back.

lines.zh: 你一抬手，我就退了一步
lines.en: You raise a hand and I give a step.
I always move before you do.
I am at your flank in a blink.
I take three steps around you.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，又看你的手
lines.en: I look up at you, then at your hands.

lines.zh: 你还没动，我已经转完一圈
lines.en: You have not moved; I have done a full turn.
I stop, tail moving.

lines.zh: 我退开一步，又靠近半步
lines.en: I step back, then half forward.

lines.zh: 我看你的鞋，不看你的脸
lines.en: I look at your shoes, not your face.
I bolt aside at once.
I run a circle before stopping.
I look back at the wound.
My breathing turns rapid.
I back behind a tree.
My legs give and I drop to one knee.
I lie low and pant.
I tuck my tail and retreat.
I turn and nip at the wound.

lines.zh: 我的脚步乱了，快不起来
lines.en: My steps break up; I cannot go fast.

lines.zh: 你手里有东西，我看见了
lines.en: I saw what is in your hand.
One step and I am in front of you.
I will not snatch; I fear startling you.

lines.zh: 你手里的味道，让我停不下来。
lines.en: The smell in your hand won't let me stop moving.
I stop, eyes fixed.
My nose works quickly.
I push my head in, quickly.
I bite once and let go.
I look up, waiting for the next bite.
I circle your hand.
We collide and I spring away first.
I turn and I am out of the way.
You hit my hindquarters.
I loop half around and hit again.

lines.zh: 我的脚在地上滑了一小段
lines.en: My feet slide a short way.
I dodge and you hit air.

lines.zh: 我撞到你侧面，立刻跑开
lines.en: I hit your side and run off at once.

lines.zh: 我绕过你的腿又撞一下
lines.en: I go around your legs and strike again.
You step on my tail tip.

lines.zh: 我一个急停，你从旁边过去
lines.en: I brake hard and you pass by.
She runs a little faster than me.

lines.zh: 我们绕着对方跑了一圈
lines.en: We circle each other once.
She stops, tail high.
I come close and sniff.

lines.zh: 我们一起朝同一个方向冲
lines.en: We dash the same way together.
We run one behind the other.

lines.zh: 她回头看我，跑得慢了一点
lines.en: She looks back and slows a little.

lines.zh: 我们一起急停，一起转向
lines.en: We brake and turn together.
She leans in and licks my ear.
We crouch in the grass together.
I run over and brake hard.
One bite, and I run.
I shake it twice.
It is so light I nearly bite air.
I run off again.
I dip my head and have it.
I toss it up and catch it.
I run two strides with it held.
I crouch and pin it with a paw.
I hide it in a clump of grass.
I stop dead.

lines.zh: 我的身体压低，随时要跑
lines.en: I sink low, ready to run.

lines.zh: 你还在原地，我已经绕到侧面
lines.en: You are still there; I am already at your flank.
I break into quick small strides.
I stop with one leg lifted.
My eyes fix on you.
My tail has flattened.
I begin to inch forward.
My breathing turns shallow.

lines.zh: 我的影子跟你叠在一起
lines.en: My shadow overlaps yours.
I move to the windy side.
You look back and I freeze.
I run fast circles around you.
Even running, I keep you in sight.
You turn slowly; I am quick.
Closer each time. Stop counting.

lines.zh: 我停下来，又立刻跑起来
lines.en: I stop, then run again at once.
I run loops, closer each time.
I stop just above your line of sight.

lines.zh: 你转过去，我就从另一边来
lines.en: You turn away; I come from the other side.
I do not stop; I only circle.
My steps fall quick as rain.
You cannot count my circles.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的背，一闪就过去。
lines.en: I skim your back and flash past.
I dash in and hit your leg.

lines.zh: 我一转身，尾巴抽在你的膝上
lines.en: I spin and my tail strikes your knee.
I bite once and run.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上抓出痕
lines.en: My claws leave marks on the ground.
I dash in and bite your hand.
I spin and hit you head on.

lines.zh: 我这一爪带着跑起来的冲劲
lines.en: This claw carries the momentum of my sprint.
I bite, then circle to the other side.
My forepaws catch your waist.
You grab me; I twist free.
I arrive before the footsteps are heard.

lines.zh: 我站在空地上，喘得很轻
lines.en: I stand in the open, breathing lightly.

lines.zh: 风把我的味道吹向后面
lines.en: The wind carries my scent behind me.
I look both ways twice.
My feet have already started to shift.

lines.zh: 我朝着你要来的方向看
lines.en: I look the way you will come.

lines.zh: 我一路跑过来，停下时打滑
lines.en: I run up and skid to a stop.
I lift my head and sweep the area.
My feet move before I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 我刚跑完，尾巴还甩个不停。
lines.en: Just finished running, and my tail still won't stop swishing.
The dust has not settled yet.
I settle, breaths short.

lines.zh: 火苗一靠近，我已经跑出很远
lines.en: The flames come near and I am already far off.

lines.zh: 我摔了一跤，马上爬起来
lines.en: I trip and I am up at once.
Water enters my mouth and I kick fast.

lines.zh: 爆风推了我一把，我顺势跑
lines.en: The blast pushes me and I run with it.
Something slices my hind leg.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的腿慢了一拍
lines.en: That force slows my legs a beat.
Hungry, two strides and I am winded.

lines.zh: 雷落在身后，我跑得更快
lines.en: Lightning strikes behind me and I run faster.

lines.zh: 地面没有了，我的腿还在跑
lines.en: The ground is gone; my legs keep running.
